item.title: UPDATE: Found Safe
item.description: According to Tennessee Missing and Unsolved on Facebook, a young man has gone missing in Jackson, TN. His parents are actively seeking information of his whereabouts.

item.title: Person of interest detained in Brown University shooting that killed 2 and wounded 9
item.description: A person of interest was in custody Sunday after a shooting during final exams at Brown University that killed two students and wounded nine others, though key questions remained unanswered more than 12 hours after the attack.

item.title: ‘Zootopia 2’ reclaims No. 1 spot at box office, grosses $1B worldwide
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — “Zootopia 2” regained the No. 1 spot at the domestic box office with $26.3 million in its third weekend of release, according to studio estimates Sunday, as The Walt Disney Co. animated sequel became the year’s second film to gross $1 billion worldwide. With “Avatar: Fire and Ash” arriving Friday, it was a relatively quiet weekend...
